Rahul Kapoor
Senior Data Engineer | Cochin
rahul.kapoor166@example.com | +91 9348679524

Seasoned data engineering professional with a track record of designing and delivering scalable ETL pipelines, data warehouses, and analytics-ready datasets. Strong focus on performance tuning, cost optimization, and cross-functional collaboration to enable data-driven decisions. Open to new opportunities; current notice period: 60 days.

Experience

Accenture — Mar 2020 - Present
Senior Data Engineer
- Led redesign of SQL-based ETL workflows, reducing query runtime by 45% and lowering cluster costs by 30% through optimized indexing, partitioning, and query refactoring using SQL and Spark.
- Built and productionized Spark jobs to process 2 TB of daily event data, improving downstream dashboard freshness from 6 hours to under 1 hour.
- Implemented monitoring and alerting for data quality using automated SQL checks; caught and resolved seven high-impact data anomalies in the first year.
- Collaborated with analytics and product teams via Jira and Git, enabling CI/CD for data pipelines and reducing deployment incidents by 60%.

GreenGrid — Jul 2015 - Feb 2020
Data Engineer
- Architected Snowflake data warehouse schemas and ETL using dbt models, cutting ETL runtime by 70% and improving analytic query performance for business users.
- Migrated historical data (500M+ rows) into Snowflake with zero downtime by orchestrating incremental dbt runs and verification queries.
- Developed reusable dbt macros and documented CI workflows in Git, increasing developer productivity and standardizing transformation logic.
- Partnered with stakeholders to define SLAs and implemented monitoring dashboards that tracked job success rates and latency, achieving 99.5% pipeline uptime.

Capgemini — May 2013 - Jun 2015
Big Data Engineer
- Developed Python-based data ingestion services to stream logs into HDFS and S3, processing peak loads of 10k events/sec using Spark streaming.
- Orchestrated complex ETL workflows with Apache Airflow, scheduling dependencies across Spark jobs and AWS services to meet nightly SLA windows.
- Tuned Spark applications for memory and executor configuration, reducing job failures by 40% and improving throughput by 35%.
- Managed deployments and automation on AWS, leveraging Linux servers and Git-based source control; documented runbooks and recovery procedures.

Projects
- Real-time Anomaly Detection Pipeline: Built a Spark streaming prototype with Python to detect metric anomalies, integrated alerting, and demonstrated a 25% faster detection time versus batch approaches.
- dbt Style Guide & Macro Library: Created a reusable dbt macro library and style guide used by internal teams to standardize transformations and simplify code reviews.

Skills
Languages: Python, SQL
Stack: Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt
Cloud/Tools: AWS, Git, Jira, Linux

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
